items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: It's done by a guy named Ralston.

ctx.x: Yeah. How do you like that painting now? Oh, that's right. Who did that to?
No, no. That's in a book. That's a book. Oh yeah. That's an Overseas Highway it's called. It's down there. Oh. In Florida, going from one of the keys to another. It's done by a guy named Ralston.

Yeah, yeah. Now you know, you know, you put a highway. You have to leave. You have to leave. You have to leave with London. And you go into the journey. Man, they got a highway. Beautiful. I'm telling you, Jesus Christ. It's a beautiful highway. Oh, man.
